content: मस्ज् €6 <ab>P.</ab> (मज्जति, मग्न; {%<ab>caus.</ab>%} मज्जयति; {%<ab>desid.</ab>%} मिमङ्क्षति) .²1 To bathe, plunge, dip or throw oneself into water; यद्गोप्रतरकल्पोऽभूत् संमर्दस्तत्र मज्जताम् <ls>R. 15. 101</ls>; <ls>Bv. 2. 95</ls>. .²2 To sink, sink into or down, sink under, plunge (with <ab>loc.</ab> or <ab>acc.</ab>); सीदन्नन्धे तमसि विधुरो मज्जतीवान्तरात्मा <ls>U. 3. 38</ls>; <ls>Māl. 9. 20</ls>; सोऽसंवृतं नाम तमः सह तेनैव मज्जति <ls>Ms. 4. 81</ls>; <ls>R. 16. 72</ls>. .²3 To be drowned, perish (in water). .²4 To sink into misfortune. .²5 To despond, be discouraged or disheartened. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (मज्जयति) .²1 To cause to sink, immerse, dip, drown. .²2 To deluge, inundate, overwhelm. .²3 To thrust, to pass into; ततो मर्मसु मर्मज्ञो मज्जयन् निशितान् शरान् <ls>Rām. 6. 45. 15</ls>.
